test_rolling_apply_invalid_raw: test that rolling apply raises ValueError when raw parameter is not True or False
test_rolling_apply_out_of_bounds: test rolling apply with window larger than data length and min_periods
test_rolling_apply_with_pandas_objects: test rolling apply with pandas Series and DataFrame objects using time-based windows
test_rolling_apply: test rolling apply with step parameter on empty and NaN Series
test_rolling_apply_args_kwargs: test rolling apply passing custom args and kwargs to the applied function
test_nans: test rolling apply behavior with NaN values and varying min_periods
test_center: test centered rolling apply with NaN values at boundaries
test_invalid_engine: test that rolling apply raises ValueError for unsupported engine values
test_invalid_engine_kwargs_cython: test that cython engine rejects engine_kwargs parameter
test_invalid_raw_numba: test that numba engine requires raw=True parameter
test_ragged_apply: test rolling apply on irregularly-spaced time-indexed DataFrames
test_all_apply: test rolling apply with equal window and time-based window produce same result
test_min_periods: test rolling apply with varying min_periods and step values
test_center_reindex_series: test centered rolling apply equivalence with shifted reindexed series
test_center_reindex_frame: test centered rolling apply equivalence with shifted reindexed DataFrame
